FileSystemManager.moveFile(Object object)

Moving a file (The folder cannot be moved. The target path is a directory. If a file with the same name already exists in the target directory, the file cannot be moved,Minimum version: 23.6.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
srcPath String Yes Source file path. (Local path, which can only be in the usr directory. It can be a relative directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory.Temporary path and cache path files cannot be moved)
destPath String Yes Destination directory path. (Local path, which can only be in the usr directory. It can be a relative directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory. cannot be a temporary path or cache path.)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.moveFile({
  srcPath: `resourcePath`,
  destPath: `targetPath`,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail(err){
    console.log(err);
  }
});

Tips

  1. If a file with the same name already exists in the target path, the file cannot be moved.
